mapper.sql: id, municipality_id as municipalityId, item_key as itemKey, destination_type, bin_color, source_url
mapper.select: select from sorting_item where municipality_id = #{municipalityId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into sorting_item (municipality_id, item_key, destination_type, bin_color, source_url) values (#{municipalityId}, #{itemKey}, #{destinationType}, #{binColor}, #{sourceUrl})
